title: Ghost Homes
description: /homes command similar to Donut SMP. (OG donut smp)
body:
👻 ɢʜᴏsᴛ ʜᴏᴍᴇs
A sleek, modern, and high-performance home management plugin designed specifically for competitive servers. Say goodbye to messy, text-heavy chat commands. GhostHomes provides players with a beautiful, interactive Virtual GUI menu to manage, visit, and delete their saved locations smoothly.

🌟 Key Features:

⚡ Clean Small-Caps Design: Matches the signature server aesthetic with modern, clean typography across all inventory frames and system menus.

🏡 Seamless Home Management: Allows players to instantly save their current coordinates and return to them later with a single click.
